crossRefs.note: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble…
For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be…

translations.web: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
translations.bsb: His young ones feast on blood; and where the slain are, there he is.”
translations.kjv: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
translations.asv: Her young ones also suck up blood: And where the slain are, there is she.
